subject: Bridging merit budget for EU->US transfer — accelerated adjustment request
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bridging merit budget for EU->US transfer — accelerated adjustment request

Hi all,

Quick note — we have a transfer in the Infra team where an IC is moving from our Dublin org into an SF-based role effective 6/1. That move triggers a geo-driven comp reset that would normally take until the next cycle (Q4 merit). Manager is requesting an accelerated merit alignment to avoid retention risk.

Summary: the manager is asking for a 12% base increase (split between merit adjustment and spot) to match local comp bands and preserve internal parity. Net FY run-rate impact is ~USD 18k. I attached a short calc and manager rationale.

Why this is urgent: the engineer has an external offer that is competitive in the US market; losing them right now would jeopardize a live project (Greenfield Health integration) and slow deliverables. We also have a tight timeline for ramping an external contractor if we lose them.

Request: approval for an exception to apply an out-of-cycle merit adjustment effective 6/1, with the change coded to FY27 special adjustments (budget code: ENG-EXC-27). If possible, we need a conditional quick yes/no today so we can communicate to the manager and candidate.

Attachments: geo_merit_calcs_05-04.xlsx (calc), manager_summary.pdf (manager note).

Thanks — Soojin

Soojin Lee
Director, Infrastructure Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridging merit budget for EU->US transfer — accelerated adjustment request

Thanks Soojin — quick clarifying Qs before I can sign off:

- Can you confirm total FY impact and whether this pushes the manager over their team budget (headcount-adjusted)? The workbook shows a $18k run-rate but I want the validated ledger code.
- Is the increase permanent base or a one-time spot + temporary base top-up?
- Any precedents in the last 12 months for geo-bridging in this team?

If it's strictly to match required local pay and the manager commits to the retention milestone (6 months), we can often do a limited exception with a partial spot and a smaller base uplift. I can get an interim approval for $12k run-rate; beyond that requires Lauren/Finance sign-off.

CC: Laura — can you confirm available funding (ENG-EXC-27) and whether we can reallocate from the hiring float?

— Marissa
Compensation & Total Rewards
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridging merit budget for EU->US transfer — accelerated adjustment request

Marissa — I pulled the ENG-EXC-27 ledger. We have ~USD 95k uncommitted for this fiscal period after planned hires; reallocating $12k to cover a partial uplift is straightforward. Anything >$15k needs VP finance approval and will require tagging for FY28 planning.

I recommend: approve up to $12k run-rate as a spot + conditional base review at next cycle. For full 12% permanent base uplift (~$18k), we need Lauren sign-off and a short memo for the exec compensation committee.

Laura
VP Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridging merit budget for EU->US transfer — accelerated adjustment request

Thanks everyone — I understand the retention risk and the downstream impact on the Greenfield Health deliverable. Approve the following path:

1) Immediate approval for a one-time spot payment equivalent to a 6% uplift (estimated $9k run-rate) to be coded to ENG-EXC-27; manager to communicate acceptance terms.
2) Temporary base uplift of 6% effective 6/1 for 6 months, then revert pending formal merit cycle review — this reduces the immediate risk while minimizing permanent comp pressure.
3) If the manager can present a brief 1-page memo by 5/14 justifying the full 12% permanent uplift (market comps + project impact), I will take to exec comp committee for consideration.

Condition: Manager commits to a 6-month retention milestone and a knowledge-transfer plan for Greenfield Health. If employee leaves before milestone, the spot is clawback-able.

Lauren
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Amanda @ Greenfield <amanda@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: greenfield-procure@greenfieldhealth.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 16:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridging merit budget for EU->US transfer — accelerated adjustment request

Update for the thread and for our external partner:

- We will proceed with Lauren's approved path: 6% spot + 6% temporary base for 6 months effective 6/1. Payroll will code the spot and temporary base to ENG-EXC-27.
- Manager will submit the 1-page memo by 5/14 if they want full 12% to be considered by exec committee.
- Laura confirmed funding availability for the $12k immediate impact.

Amanda — this is internal to our comp process, but wanted to loop you in because the talent continuity is important for the Greenfield Health integration schedule. We expect no disruption to current milestones. I'll confirm final resource assignment by 5/10.

Thanks everyone. Attaching the approval_form.docx for HR to process paperwork.

— Soojin
Director, Infrastructure Programs
Redwood Inference
Attachment: approval_form.docx (HR approval form)
